all_msgs = []
page = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.phone.search_text_messages(access_token=phone_token, query='Splitwise', page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_msgs.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print(f"Total messages with 'Splitwise': {len(all_msgs)}")
